targets.rawSql: SELECT (sports_turnover - sports_payouts + casino_staked - casino_returned) / 100.0 AS ggr FROM warehouse.daily_figures WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
SELECT sports_turnover / 100.0 AS turnover FROM warehouse.daily_figures WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
SELECT coupons FROM warehouse.daily_figures WHERE day = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
SELECT CASE WHEN matched THEN 'Matches' ELSE 'MISMATCH' END AS result FROM warehouse.reconciliation_runs ORDER BY ran_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT day::timestamp AS time, (sports_turnover - sports_payouts) / 100.0 AS sports, (casino_staked - casino_returned) / 100.0 AS casino FROM warehouse.daily_figures WHERE day::timestamp BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY 1

SELECT day, coupons, sports_turnover / 100.0 AS sports_turnover, sports_payouts / 100.0 AS sports_payouts, casino_staked / 100.0 AS casino_staked, casino_returned / 100.0 AS casino_returned, (sports_turnover - sports_payouts + casino_staked - casino_returned) / 100.0 AS ggr FROM warehouse.daily_figures ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 60
